summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan to build the Calisthenics Academy section in AURAMORPH.
Features:
- Track selection (Fitness & Nutrition, Calisthenics, Both) on AuthView & Onboarding
- Dedicated 'Calisthenics' navigation tab & glowing neon-purple theme
- 3 skill tiers (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) covering all 23 requested skills
- Real verified YouTube video tutorials in an expandable inline drawer per exercise
- Step-by-step cues, safety guidelines, common mistakes, and progression trees
- Skill mastery tracking and progression system saved in Firestore and local state
- Strict preservation of all existing diet, workout, biometrics, and AI coach features
